description: Configuration script for setting up Vitest testing environment for extension messaging, including functions to load include patterns from environment variables and create a scoped test configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables or defaults to loading from 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE' based on provided environment object.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig( createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for extension messaging tests, merging include patterns from environment or default roots with additional config options.
